title: Saturation ↔ Richness
idiom: Haeckel-style scientific engraving — a precise technical diagram rendered with the warmth of a 19th-century naturalist plate
hero_prompt: Wide 12:5 format, dark sepia-toned background. A Haeckel-style scientific engraving showing a single clean waveform on the left transforming rightward into a rich harmonic stack — like a tree of overtones branching upward from a single root frequency. The lines are hand-engraved, precise yet organic, with fine crosshatching giving depth to the harmonic branches. At center a glowing tube filament suggests warmth at the threshold. Balanced group of a woman and a man at laboratory instruments in the foreground, rendered in the same engraving style. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem on near-black background: a single thick waveform line on the left that fans into three thicker harmonic arcs on the right, like a river delta. No fine linework — all strokes at least 3px equivalent. Warm amber or golden tones on black. No letters, numerals, words, labels.
